verdict.rationale: Pipedream's homepage says users can "Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents," which suggests some first-party natural-language operation. It also offers AI-assisted error debugging. Both are single thin marketing or docs mentions with no detail on how prompts drive the product. The MCP server lets external agents call integrated app APIs, but that belongs to the separate MCP story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of a natural-language interface for building and managing workflows, its scope and limits, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
